title: Standards ingestion: reference by default, copy only when out of root
description: Standards packs are per operator or organisation and register at `rcf init` (or later via `rcf define standards add`). Manifest registration is authoritative. In-repo sources are referenced in place. Out-of-root sources are copied into `rcf/standards/<slug>/` so the tree remains portable. Provenance (personal vs corporate) is recorded per pack.
iWant: to register standards packs against my project tree, referencing in place when the source is already inside the repo and copying into `rcf/standards/<slug>/` only when the source lives outside the project root
soThat: duplication inside the repo is not accepted, portability across machines is preserved for external sources, and the manifest is the single source of truth for what standards apply

acceptanceCriteria.description: `rcf define standards add <path>` writes a manifest entry with the pack's id, slug, sourcePath, tag vocabulary, testsProvidedBy and provenance
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project with no standards registered and a valid standards folder anywhere on disk
acceptanceCriteria.when: `rcf define standards add <path> --slug wsd-naming --tags naming,conventions --tests-provided-by agent --provenance corporate` runs
acceptanceCriteria.then: the manifest gains one `standards[]` entry with all named fields populated and validates against the schema

acceptanceCriteria.description: In-repo sources are referenced in place; no copy is written
acceptanceCriteria.given: a standards folder path inside the project root (e.g. `docs/standards/wsd-naming`)
acceptanceCriteria.when: `rcf define standards add` runs against it
acceptanceCriteria.then: the `sourcePath` records the in-repo path, `copyPath` is absent, and no file is written under `rcf/standards/`

acceptanceCriteria.description: Out-of-root sources are mirrored into `rcf/standards/<slug>/` and `copyPath` records the mirror
acceptanceCriteria.given: a standards folder path outside the project root (an absolute path pointing outside the repo)
acceptanceCriteria.when: `rcf define standards add` runs against it
acceptanceCriteria.then: the source is copied into `rcf/standards/<slug>/`, the manifest entry records the original `sourcePath` and the in-tree `copyPath`, and re-running the verb is idempotent (no double copy)

acceptanceCriteria.description: The manifest.standards[] entry validates against the shipped schema (@stravica-ai/rcf-schemas standardsPackRecord)
acceptanceCriteria.given: a manifest with one or more standards[] entries
acceptanceCriteria.then: the manifest validates without errors under the shipped schema
